telemetry_columns.name: event_id
telemetry_columns.description: Monotonically increasing event counter, one per gate application

telemetry_columns.name: depth
telemetry_columns.description: Current circuit depth (layer number) of this gate

telemetry_columns.name: gate_idx
telemetry_columns.description: Zero-based index of this gate within the current layer

telemetry_columns.name: execution_time_ns
telemetry_columns.description: Wall-clock time to apply this gate, including any implicit telemetry overhead

telemetry_columns.name: l3_misses_delta
telemetry_columns.description: L3 cache misses since previous event, measured via PAPI

telemetry_columns.name: tlb_misses_delta
telemetry_columns.description: Data TLB misses since previous event, measured via PAPI

telemetry_columns.name: working_set_kb
telemetry_columns.description: Unique 4KB pages accessed since circuit start, via address trace sampling

telemetry_columns.name: stride_entropy
telemetry_columns.description: Shannon entropy of memory stride distribution over last 128 gate accesses

telemetry_columns.name: half_chain_entropy
telemetry_columns.description: Von Neumann entropy of half-chain reduced density matrix. Computed at even layers only; null for odd layers and all non-bipartition events.
